subject: Activation call: align MAP, evaluation milestones, and roles
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@orbitanalytics.com>, contracts@orbitanalytics.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation call to align MAP & evaluation milestones

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. To keep momentum and make sure we meet your October close window, I'd like to schedule a 45–60 minute MAP activation call to align on:

- Key success criteria and evaluation metrics
- Stakeholder roles and decision owners (procurement, security, dev)
- Short-term milestones and acceptance tests for evaluation
- Contract and procurement timing

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 6 Oct 10:00–11:00
- Tue 6 Oct 14:00–15:00
- Wed 7 Oct 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm which works and who from your side will attend (name + role)? I've attached a lightweight MAP template to help surface gaps ahead of the call.

High level ask for the call: please have your security and contract owners available or at least on standby for Q&A.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: MAP_Sample_Template_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: priya.singh@orbitanalytics.com, contracts@orbitanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation call to align MAP & evaluation milestones

Thanks Hannah — Tue 6 Oct 10:00 PT works for us. I'll attend and will bring Priya Singh (Evaluation lead) and our contracts alias so we can jump on procurement timing. I've asked our security engineer (same team) to be available for the call.

Can you include a calendar invite + Zoom link and a short agenda? We'll also share a one-page evaluation checklist as a pre-read.

Jordan
VP Product | Orbit Analytics
jordan.ellis@orbitanalytics.com
Attachment: SOW-outline.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@orbitanalytics.com>, priya.singh@orbitanalytics.com, contracts@orbitanalytics.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation call — calendar invite and draft agenda

Great — confirmed: Tue 6 Oct 10:00–10:50 PT (45 min). Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orbit-map-activation-7543

Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abc123

Draft agenda (attached):
1) Intros & objectives (5m)
2) MAP overview & timeline (10m) — I'll run this
3) Evaluation plan & success metrics (15m) — Marissa will lead
4) Security & data handling Q&A (10m) — please have your security contact ready
5) Procurement next steps & contract cadence (5m) — Sean to cover high-level options

Please confirm attendees and any additions to the agenda. I've attached the current agenda and a working MAP spreadsheet — if you'd like a private copy to edit ahead of time I can share a Drive link.

Thanks,

Hannah
Attachment: MAP_Activation_Agenda_v0.2.pdf (application/pdf); mutual_action_plan_draft.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Related doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3MAPdocs

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Activation call — calendar invite and draft agenda

Quick note — I'll own the 'Procurement next steps' slide and can present three pricing/timeline options (PO + contract, short-term pilot, dedicated reserved capacity). Ben, can you prepare the pricing summary and one-slide comparison for Tue? I'll drop a 1‑page pre-read into the Drive this afternoon.

Marissa — can you confirm you'll cover evaluation metrics and a proposed pass/fail rubric? If you want, I can add a brief section in the pre-read for the scoring matrix.

Thanks — Sean
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com

- Jordan Ellis (VP Product)
